arxiv-1404-5035.title: n n -widths and Approximation theory on Compact Riemannian Manifolds
arxiv-1404-5035.description: Abstract . We determine upper asymptotic estimates of Kolmogorov and linear n n -widths of unit balls in Sobolev and Besov norms in L p L_{p} -spaces on compact Riemannian manifolds. The proofs rely on estimates for the near-diagonal localization of the kernels of elliptic operators.

arxiv-2209-03871.title: Density, not radius, separates rocky and water-rich small planets orbiting M dwarf stars
arxiv-2209-03871.creator: Rafael Luque & Enric Pallé
arxiv-2209-03871.description: Abstract Exoplanets smaller than Neptune are common around red dwarf stars (M dwarfs), with those that transit their host star constituting the bulk of known temperate worlds amenable for atmospheric characterization. We analyze the masses and radii of all known small transiting planets around M dwarfs, identifying three populations: rocky, water-rich, and gas-rich.

arxiv-2508-18842.description: Abstract The large number of degrees of freedom involved in polaritonic chemistry processes considerably restricts the systems that can be described by any ab initio approach, due to the resulting high computational cost. pmc-10525174.title: Direct Estimation of Equivalent Bioelectric Sources Based on Huygens’ Principle
pmc-10525174.creator: Georgia Theodosiadou, Dimitrios G Arnaoutoglou, Ioannis Nannis, Sotirios Katsimentes, Georgios Ch Sirakoulis, George A Kyriacou, Larbi Boubchir
pmc-10525174.description: An estimation of the electric sources in the heart was conducted using a novel method, based on Huygens’ Principle, aiming at a direct estimation of equivalent bioelectric sources over the heart’s surface in real time. The main scope of this work was to establish a new, fast approach to the solution of the inverse electrocardiography problem.

pmc-11293179.title: Strain-dependent induction of primary bile acid 7-dehydroxylation by cholic acid
pmc-11293179.creator: Eduard Vico-Oton, Colin Volet, Nicolas Jacquemin, Yuan Dong, Siegfried Hapfelmeier, Karin Lederballe Meibom, Rizlan Bernier-Latmani
pmc-11293179.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundBile acids (BAs) are steroid-derived molecules with important roles in digestion, the maintenance of host metabolism, and immunomodulation. Primary BAs are synthesized by the host, while secondary BAs are produced by the gut microbiome through transformation of the former. The regulation of microbial production of secondary BAs is not well understood, particularly the production of 7-dehydroxylated BAs, which are the most potent agonists for host BA receptors.

pmc-11356229.title: Genetic Diversity in Salmonella enterica in Outbreaks of Foodborne and Zoonotic Origin in the USA in 2006–2017
pmc-11356229.creator: Eija Trees, Heather A Carleton, Jason P Folster, Laura Gieraltowski, Kelley Hise, Molly Leeper, Thai-An Nguyen, Angela Poates, Ashley Sabol, Kaitlin A Tagg, Beth Tolar, Michael Vasser, Hattie E Webb, Matthew Wise, Rebecca L Lindsey, Changsun Choi
pmc-11356229.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Whole genome sequencing is replacing traditional laboratory surveillance methods as the primary tool to track and characterize clusters and outbreaks of the foodborne and zoonotic pathogen Salmonella enterica (S. In this study, 438 S. enterica isolates representing 35 serovars and 13 broad vehicle categories from one hundred epidemiologically confirmed outbreaks were evaluated for genetic variation to develop epidemiologically relevant interpretation guidelines for Salmonella disease cluster detection.

pmc-11480014.description: Neonicotinoids are the most widely used class of insecticides in the United States (U.S.). and the world. Consistent with their high use and persistence, neonicotinoids are often found contaminating drinking water and food. They are also detected in human urine, breast milk, amniotic and cerebrospinal fluids, as well as the brains of treated rodents.

pmc-11488483.creator: S. Vock, A. Hofmann, M. Lehnung, K. Böhm, S. Wieland, G. H. Seidler, E. Beiner, M. Hermes, H.-C. Friederich, W. Eich, J. Tesarz
pmc-11488483.description: BackgroundEye Movement Desensitization and Reprocessing (EMDR) is an evidence-based treatment, primarily established for post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD). While it is increasingly being applied to chronic pain, its efficacy in this area is not yet supported by the same level of evidence as that which exists for PTSD.

pmc-11497061.description: As an alternative to thermionic X‐ray generators, cold‐cathode X‐ray tubes are being developed for portable and multichannel tomography. pmc-11639764.creator: Jiali Zhou, Xinrui Zhang, Yujie Wang, Haoxian Liang, Yuhao Yang, Xiaolei Huang, Jun Deng, Gianluca Tettamanti
pmc-11639764.description: Simple SummaryThe ignorance of data quality such as data contamination will cause incorrect conclusions and misdirection. pmc-12559324.title: Variable gradient-based phase locked loop for accurate frequency estimation of distorted grids
pmc-12559324.creator: Xiaoben Lei, Xinhua Hu, Jianwei Yang, Guangqi Li, Zhiyong Dai, Guoqing Wang
pmc-12559324.description: A variable gradient-based phase locked loop (VG-PLL) is developed for distorted grids. Firstly, the large-signal model of the synchronous reference frame phase locked loop (SRF-PLL) with harmonic disturbances is established, and the large-signal model shows that the SRF-PLL has poor filtering effects in estimating the grid frequency. To address this issue, a VG-PLL is then proposed.

pmc-12993216.title: Developmental human brain connectome from fetal stage to early childhood
pmc-12993216.creator: Wentao Wu, Hao Huang, Tianjia Zhu, Shufang Tan, Minhui Ouyang
pmc-12993216.description: The human brain undergoes the most rapid maturation across the lifespan from the fetal stage through early childhood. Diffusion magnetic resonance imaging (dMRI) and resting-state functional MRI (rs-fMRI) enable noninvasive mapping of the emerging brain structural and functional connections, which can subsequently be examined using various network-based analytic approaches to characterize how brain network topology evolves during development.

pmc-13430855.title: Women’s experiences of discussing health behaviours within their maternity care: a systematic review and meta-synthesis
pmc-13430855.creator: Lucy Hulme, Debbie M Smith, Sarah Peters
pmc-13430855.description: IntroductionHealth behaviours are important because they have been linked to pregnancy outcomes. During maternity care women are provided with health information, but little is known about how women experience these discussions. Therefore, a systematic review was conducted to investigate women’s experiences of discussing health behaviours within their maternity care interactions.
